params.blurb2: He then gains a brief {{tip|shield}} that absorbs {{as|magic damage}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at the target enemy that deals magic damage and disrupts their ongoing channels.

blurb2.plain: He then gains a brief shield that absorbs magic damage.

description.plain: Active: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at the target enemy that deals magic damage and disrupts their ongoing channels.

description2.plain: He also gains a shield that absorbs magic damage for 1.5 seconds.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' empowers his blade, causing his next basic attack within a few seconds to gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}}, deal increased {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}, with the restoration amount quintupled against {{tip|champion|champions}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kassadin's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|25|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' empowers his next basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, deal increased {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and restore {{sti|{{as|mana}}}}, with the restoration amount quintupled against {{tip|champion|champions}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Increased Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Mana Restored|{{as|{{ap|4 to 6}}% of '''missing''' mana}}|Mana Restored Against Champions|{{as|{{ap|4*5 to 6*5}}% of '''missing''' mana}}}}
params.description3: ''Nether Blade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kassadin's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* The passive damage applies {{tip|proc damage}} and the active damage applies {{tip|spell damage}}.
* The enhanced attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal.
* ''Nether Blade'' will not grant mana if the attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}} or if it {{tip|blind|misses}}, but will do so if the attack is {{tip|block|blocked}}. In all cases the damage is parried.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the ''active'' damage but not the ''passive'' one.
* The passive '''bonus''' damage applies to structures.
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|structures}}.

blurb.plain: Passive: Kassadin basic attacks deal bonus magic damage.

blurb2.plain: Active: Kassadin empowers his blade, causing his next basic attack within a few seconds to gain bonus range, deal increased bonus magic damage, and restore mana, with the restoration amount quintupled against champions.

description.plain: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal 25 (+ 10% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit.

description2.plain: Active: Kassadin empowers his next basic attack on-hit within 5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, deal increased bonus magic damage, and restore mana, with the restoration amount quintupled against champions.

description3.plain: Nether Blade resets Kassadin's basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kassadin}} {{tip|blinks}} toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival. He then gains a stack of ''Riftwalk'', stacking up to a cap.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Riftwalk:}} For each stack, ''Riftwalk'' gains '''bonus''' damage and increased {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kassadin''' {{tip|blinks}} toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon arrival. He then gains a stack of ''Riftwalk'' for 15 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 4 times.
params.description2: {{sbc|Riftwalk:}} For each stack, ''Riftwalk'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} at an increased {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}}.
params.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Damage Per Stack|{{ap|35 to 55}} {{as|(+ 7% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% '''maximum''' mana)}}|Maximum Bonus Damage|{{ap|35*4 to 55*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|7*4}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% '''maximum''' mana)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|80+35*4 to 110+55*4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50+7*4}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' mana)}}}}
params.notes:
* {{si|Flash}} can be used during the cast time, allowing '''Kassadin''' to blink further away.
* [[Ping]]ing ''Riftwalk'' will additionally display the remaining duration of its stacks.

blurb.plain: Active: Kassadin blinks toward the target location, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies upon arrival. He then gains a stack of Riftwalk, stacking up to a cap.

blurb4.plain: Riftwalk: For each stack, Riftwalk gains bonus damage and increased mana cost.

description.plain: Active: Kassadin blinks toward the target location, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies upon arrival. He then gains a stack of Riftwalk for 15 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 4 times.

description2.plain: Riftwalk: For each stack, Riftwalk deals bonus magic damage at an increased mana cost.
